links.outcome: Inter-reviewer agreement on human ground truth for extracted variables
links.effect: Reviewer agreement for presence of certain variables varied considerably (52%-99%); human agreement positively correlated with model accuracy (r = 0.67, p = 0.0003).
links.quote: Reviewer agreement for the presence of certain variables varied considerably (52 %-99 %).

links.outcome: Sensitivity of model-expressed uncertainty for detecting its own errors
links.effect: Uncertainty from the model was highly sensitive for errors, ranging from 0.63 to 1.00.
links.quote: Human agreement was positively correlated with model accuracy (r = 0.67, p = 0.0003) and uncertainty from the model was highly sensitive for errors (ranging from 0.63 to 1.00).

unlisted_practices: Comparing reasoning-effort levels of LLMs for cost and latency in chart data extraction

screen.reason: The study evaluates the retrospective accuracy and efficiency of several GPT models (reasoning levels) for extracting surgical variables from operative reports compared to human reviewers.
